# Stable Rock Construction LLC

> Veteran-owned South Florida builder run by an active Florida State inspector.
> Roofing, plumbing, mechanical/HVAC, general construction, impact windows and
> doors, and kitchen & bath remodels — every trade in-house under one license.
> Serving Miami, Miami-Dade County, the Florida Keys, and Southwest Florida.

## About

Stable Rock Construction is a licensed and insured, veteran-owned general
contractor led by owner Abner Nunez. The company holds four Florida state
contractor certifications (general, roofing, plumbing, and mechanical), so every
trade is performed in-house under one license. Clients deal with one point of
contact instead of coordinating multiple subcontractors, and combining projects
(for example a re-roof plus impact windows) lowers overhead and total cost.

- Owner: Abner Nunez
- Phone: 786-622-ROOF (786-622-7663)
- Email: info@stablerockconstruction.com
- Address: 3110 NW 4th St, Miami, FL 33125
- Service area: Miami, Miami-Dade County, Florida Keys, Southwest Florida
- Free estimates; reply within one business day

## Florida state certifications (DBPR, Chapter 489)

- Certified General Contractor: CGC1521744
- Certified Roofing Contractor: CCC1332548
- Certified Plumbing Contractor: CFC1433873
- Certified Mechanical Contractor: CMC1251627

## Services

- [Roofing](https://stablerockconstruction.com/roofing): Flat and low-slope systems, full tear-offs and re-roofs, torch-down modified bitumen, metal roofing, reflective coatings, and leak repairs.
- [Plumbing](https://stablerockconstruction.com/plumbing): Whole-home repipes (PEX or copper), slab and wall leak detection, drain cleaning and camera inspection, water heaters (tank and tankless), and full rough-in.
- [Mechanical & HVAC](https://stablerockconstruction.com/mechanical-hvac): A/C installs and replacements sized by Manual J load calculation, duct repair and sealing, mini-splits, and new-construction mechanical systems.
- [General Construction](https://stablerockconstruction.com/general-construction): Ground-up residential construction, additions and second stories, structural repair, concrete and block, and permit/inspection management.
- [Impact Windows & Doors](https://stablerockconstruction.com/impact-windows-doors): NOA-compliant impact-rated windows and doors, full-frame and retrofit installs, with wind-mitigation documentation for insurance credits.
- [Remodels](https://stablerockconstruction.com/remodels): Full kitchen and bathroom remodels with in-house plumbing, electrical, tile, and finishes.

## Why Stable Rock

- Veteran-owned, licensed and insured.
- Owner is an active Florida State inspector — jobs are built to code and pass the first time.
- Every trade in-house under one license — one accountable team, one point of contact.
- Bundling projects (roof + windows, kitchen + bath, roof + A/C) saves on permits, mobilization, and labor.
